_note: Baidu aerial and ground views of the airport, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

nce-baidu-1.webp.zh: 空中俯瞰：尼斯蔚蓝海岸机场铺在伸入地中海的岬角上，跑道与航站楼夹在蔚蓝海水与城市之间。
nce-baidu-1.webp.en: Aerial view of Nice-Côte d'Azur airport on its promontory jutting into the Mediterranean, runways and terminals between the sea and the city.

nce-baidu-2.webp.zh: 从高处望向尼斯机场：航站楼、机坪与停车场在厚厚的乌云下铺展开来。
nce-baidu-2.webp.en: From above, Nice's terminal, apron and car parks spread out beneath heavy storm clouds.

nce-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，尼斯蔚蓝海岸机场（NCE）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
nce-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Nice-Côte d'Azur Airport (NCE) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
